_about: Public-domain Menno Simons (1496-1561), the Dutch Anabaptist leader whose name the Mennonites bear, for the Word Hoard, in English: The Complete Works of Menno Simon, translated from the original Dutch (Elkhart, Ind.: John F. Funk, 1871; the translator is not named), and A Foundation and Plain Instruction of the Saving Doctrine of Our Lord Jesus Christ, translated by I. Daniel Rupp (Lancaster, Pa., 1869), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 40 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

menno-complete-works-1871: The complete works of Menno Simon (Elkhart, IN : J.F. Funk and Brother, 1871)
menno-foundation-rupp-1869: A foundation and plain instruction of the saving doctrine of our Lord Jesus Christ, translated into English by I. Daniel Rupp (Lancaster, Pa.: J. E. Barr, 1869)

_alternates.menno-copies: The 1863 Lancaster printing of Rupp's Foundation; the Dutch originals (Fundament 1613, Opera 1646, Opera omnia theologica 1681) and German printings (1794, 1851, Nutzliche Anweisungen 1916)

_excluded.menno-other: Lives of Menno (Horsch 1916, de Leeuw 1860, Cassel's Geschichte der Mennoniten 1890), works by others
